request.query: For multivariate power series over a domain the weighted order is additive on products

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R),
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f * g) = MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f + MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_prod
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] [Nontrivial R] {ι : Type u_4} (w : σ → ℕ)
  (f : ι → MvPowerSeries σ R) (s : Finset ι),
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f i)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.le_weightedOrder_mul
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f + MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f * g)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul_ge
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → ℕ) {f g : MvPowerSeries σ R},
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f + MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g ≤ MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f * g)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.order_mul
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R),
  (f * g).order = f.order + g.order
